analysis_kind: exploratory source inspection prompted by actual model behavior; not a preregistered outcome or a prompt change

findings.fact: It serializes every entry of scene.objects and sets furniture_count=len(objects). In this imported adapter six immutable structural/opening records are also scene.objects.
findings.implication: Native furniture_count overcounts actual furniture by six in this run. Independent audit filters object_type. Preserve original receipts.

findings.fact: For away it casts a native local -Y XY ray against target world AABB; returns a yaw based on an orientation target point. It ignores occluding objects and Z-height differences.
findings.implication: A successful away relation is an orientation result, not bathing privacy, blocked sightlines or ergonomic access. Do not promote it into a functional label.
